sentence: People who already chat with an AI app get it to read the pages, searches and videos the app's own web search cannot open, from their own computer, and are told plainly when a site still says no.

sections.heading: What your AI can do with it

picture.claim: One add-on gives your AI five abilities: open pages that block bots, watch a video, search without a key, keep watch on a page, turn a list into rows.
shows: a video with a transcript line
three search engines agreeing
a price line with a change alert
loose blocks becoming a table
a shield over a blocked page

sections.heading: How it gets past a wall

picture.claim: When a site pushes back, Svipall climbs from the lightest way of visiting to stronger ones until it gets in, or stops and says so.
shows: a ladder of five ways of visiting
a site that answers with a wall
the way that gets in
a sign-in wall that stops the climb

picture.claim: Three lines pasted into Claude Code install it, check that it works, and leave it telling you when an update is out.
shows: a Claude Code window typing three plugin lines
a checklist that fills: marketplace added, add-on installed, checked, says when updates come

picture.claim: Everything runs on your own computer: pages go from the site to you and on to your AI app, with no sign-up, key or server in between.
shows: your computer as a fenced yard holding your AI app and Svipall
the sites you visit as blocks outside
a line to one site and its page coming back
tags: no sign-up, no key to paste, no server in between
